upsampling the query sequence.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: The reported gains are measured with external ground-truth annotations on standard benchmark evaluation sets, including novel/unseen categories, rather than with the training loss or a learned evaluator [E3825d446b707601b-B0042, E3825d446b707601b-B0050, E3825d446b707601b-B0051].
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Headline outcomes are reported as AP_novel50, AP_base50, AP_all50, AP_r, AP_c, AP_f, mAP, and mIoU against held-out ground-truth annotations on standard public benchmarks [E3825d446b707601b-B0042, E3825d446b707601b-B0043].
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: The system is trained with base-class supervised classification and bounding-box regression losses, including cosine similarity against category text embeddings, on COCO-OVD and LVIS-OVD training splits [E3825d446b707601b-B0048].

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Claims regarding superior novel-category detection and competitive cross-task segmentation performance are well-supported by quantitative comparisons against prior art and ablation tables [E3825d446b707601b-B0071, E3825d446b707601b-B0073, E3825d446b707601b-B0079, E3825d446b707601b-B0080]. The authors openly acknowledge where competitive baselines retain an advantage, such as BIND on LVIS rare AP [E3825d446b707601b-B0065].
primary.evaluation_assessment: Evaluation is conducted using established standard benchmarks (COCO-OVD, LVIS-OVD, and segmentation datasets ADE20K, PASCAL VOC, PASCAL-Context) under standard protocol splits and metrics such as AP_novel, AP_r, and mIoU [E3825d446b707601b-B0042, E3825d446b707601b-B0043]. Comprehensive component ablations across two independent base architectures (OVSeg and SED) validate individual and joint module gains [E3825d446b707601b-B0050, E3825d446b707601b-B0051, E3825d446b707601b-B0056, E3825d446b707601b-B0057, E3825d446b707601b-B0070].

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Evaluations rely strictly on external ground-truth annotations for both base and novel/unseen classes on standard public benchmarks [E3825d446b707601b-B0042, E3825d446b707601b-B0050, E3825d446b707601b-B0051].
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Standard benchmark evaluation metrics (AP_novel, AP_base, AP_r, mAP, mIoU) computed against held-out ground-truth annotations on COCO-OVD, LVIS-OVD, and segmentation benchmarks [E3825d446b707601b-B0042, E3825d446b707601b-B0043].
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Standard base-class supervised detection losses (classification loss against text embeddings and bounding-box regression loss) during training [E3825d446b707601b-B0026, E3825d446b707601b-B0048].

primary.limitations: The manuscript notes that novel-category pseudo-label coverage does not directly capture pseudo-label precision [E3825d446b707601b-B0062] and relies on established pre-trained vision-language backbones.
primary.method_assessment: The architectural components are clearly formalized with exact dimensional mappings and mathematical formulations, including cross-attention masked pooling for query initialization, cross-modal token fusion, and scale-adapted lateral correction in the decoder [E3825d446b707601b-B0022, E3825d446b707601b-B0029, E3825d446b707601b-B0032, E3825d446b707601b-B0034, E3825d446b707601b-B0037]. Implementation parameters and training hyperparameters are thoroughly specified [E3825d446b707601b-B0048].
primary.quality_rationale: The paper provides a well-motivated architectural enhancement with mathematically clear design details, comprehensive ablation studies across multiple base models, and consistent empirical gains across standard open-vocabulary detection and segmentation benchmarks.
primary.scoped_contribution: The paper proposes TMCNet, a framework for open-vocabulary object detection and semantic segmentation that injects textual semantic priors into object query construction (TGME), cross-modal alignment (CMAP), and multiscale decoding (PTCD) [E3825d446b707601b-B0008, E3825d446b707601b-B0021, E3825d446b707601b-B0024].

scholarly_quality.rationale: The paper provides a well-motivated architectural enhancement with mathematically clear design details, comprehensive ablation studies across multiple base models, and consistent empirical gains across standard open-vocabulary detection and segmentation benchmarks.
